capabilities: Save a selected PDF link rectangle as a PNG image embed
Keep a registry of crop sources with path, page, rectangle and render metadata
Refresh registered PNG crops in the active note or a folder from their source PDFs
Report crops whose source PDF changed, is missing, or conflicts on output path
extras: Freemium: free commands cover single-note save and refresh; folder refresh and changed-source reports are Pro. After sign-in the plugin queries GitHub's API for sponsorship status (no vault data sent, token kept in Obsidian secret storage). Requires Obsidian 1.13.4+. README lists untested cases (mobile, password-protected PDFs, Linux/Windows desktop) and warns that saved paths do not track file renames.
problem: Obsidian embeds of PDF regions become stale when the source PDF is edited, and there is no built-in way to re-render a saved crop in place while keeping the image link.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 total)

summary: Saves a rectangle from a local PDF page as a PNG image in the vault and re-renders it from the source PDF after the source changes.
